preamble: Lava Tactics. A `## ` heading is an activity; `#focus` after it puts it in the primary focus. A step is a `- [ ]`
line, ticked `- [x]` when it is done; `@you` marks a step only you can do. An open step starts with its id (`B14`):
name a step by it. A new step takes the highest id in the file plus one; an id never changes and is never used
again. After its id, a `@you` step says what it asks of you: `Verify:` (look or play, and say whether it is as
intended), `Decide:` (choose between options), `Provide:` (give information or material only you have) or `Do:`
(an action only you can take). A step in progress names its branch, `(branch name)`: no branch exists without an
open step here, and a finished step's branch is deleted.
